caption.en: Something in your eye? Don't rub it. Here's what to do.
caption.es: ¿Algo en el ojo? No te lo frotes. Esto es lo que debes hacer.
caption.fr: Quelque chose dans l'œil ? Ne te frotte pas. Voici quoi faire.
caption.ja: 目に何か入った？ こすらないで。対応の手順を見ていきましょう。

narration.en: Something in your eye? Don't rub it. Here's what to do.
narration.fr: Quelque chose dans l'œil ? Ne te frotte pas. Voici quoi faire.

caption.en: *1* — Wash your *hands*. Don't *rub* the eye, it can scratch the surface.
caption.es: *1* — Lávate las *manos*. No te *frotes* el ojo: puede rayar la superficie.
caption.fr: *1* — Lave-toi les *mains*. Ne *frotte* pas l'œil : tu risques de le rayer.
caption.ja: *1* — *手*を洗います。目を*こすらない*で。表面を傷つけることがあります。

narration.en: Step one. Wash your hands. Don't rub the eye, because that can scratch its surface.
narration.fr: Un : lave-toi les mains. Ne frotte pas l'œil, tu risques de le rayer.

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.9' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='11' d='M 230 800 Q 540 580 850 800 Q 540 1020 230 800 Z'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.6' cx='540' cy='800' r='95' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='10'/><circle class='f' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.4' data-o='1' cx='540' cy='800' r='40' fill='#1d1d1d' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='1.0' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='16' d='M 330 560 L 750 1040 M 750 560 L 330 1040'/>

caption.en: *2* — *Blink* a few times. Tears often wash the speck out on their own.
caption.es: *2* — *Parpadea* varias veces. Las lágrimas suelen sacar la partícula solas.
caption.fr: *2* — *Cligne* des yeux plusieurs fois. Les larmes évacuent souvent le grain toutes seules.
caption.ja: *2* — 何度か*まばたき*を。涙で異物が自然に流れ出ることがよくあります。

narration.en: Step two. Blink a few times. Tears often wash the speck out on their own.
narration.fr: Deux : cligne des yeux plusieurs fois. Les larmes évacuent souvent le grain.

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.9' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='11' d='M 230 800 Q 540 580 850 800 Q 540 1020 230 800 Z'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.6' cx='540' cy='800' r='95' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='10'/><circle class='f' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.4' data-o='1' cx='540' cy='800' r='40' fill='#1d1d1d' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='0.6' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='10' d='M 470 1010 q -20 50 0 90 q 20 -40 0 -90 M 610 1010 q -20 50 0 90 q 20 -40 0 -90'/>

caption.en: *3* — Still there? *Rinse* with clean lukewarm water or sterile saline, tilting your head so it runs off.
caption.es: *3* — ¿Sigue ahí? *Enjuaga* con agua limpia tibia o suero salino estéril, inclinando la cabeza.
caption.fr: *3* — Toujours là ? *Rince* à l'eau propre tiède ou au sérum physiologique, tête penchée.
caption.ja: *3* — まだ残っている？ きれいなぬるま湯か滅菌した生理食塩水で*洗い流し*ます。頭を傾けて。

narration.en: Step three. Still there? Rinse with clean, lukewarm water or sterile saline, tilting your head so it runs off to the side.
narration.fr: Trois : rince à l'eau tiède propre ou au sérum physiologique, tête penchée.

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.9' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='11' d='M 230 800 Q 540 580 850 800 Q 540 1020 230 800 Z'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.6' cx='540' cy='800' r='95' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='10'/><circle class='f' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.4' data-o='1' cx='540' cy='800' r='40' fill='#1d1d1d' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.6' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='12' d='M 900 560 L 700 650'/><path class='d' data-s='1.0' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='9' d='M 640 690 q -10 40 -20 70 M 600 690 q -10 50 -20 90 M 680 700 q -5 40 -15 70'/>

caption.en: A speck under the *upper lid*? Gently pull the upper lid *over the lower* one so lashes sweep it away.
caption.es: ¿Una partícula bajo el *párpado superior*? Tira suavemente de él *sobre el inferior* para que las pestañas la barran.
caption.fr: Un grain sous la *paupière supérieure* ? Tire-la doucement *par-dessus l'inférieure* : les cils le balaient.
caption.ja: *上まぶた*の裏なら、上まぶたをそっと*下まぶたにかぶせ*、まつげで払い出します。

narration.en: A speck under the upper lid? Gently pull the upper lid over the lower one, so the lashes can sweep it away.
narration.fr: Un grain sous la paupière supérieure ? Tire-la doucement par-dessus l'inférieure.

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.9' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='11' d='M 230 800 Q 540 580 850 800 Q 540 1020 230 800 Z'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.6' cx='540' cy='800' r='95' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='10'/><circle class='f' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.4' data-o='1' cx='540' cy='800' r='40' fill='#1d1d1d' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='0.6' data-d='0.7' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='10' d='M 540 560 V 640 M 500 610 L 540 650 L 580 610'/>

caption.en: *Don't* try to remove anything *stuck* in the eye, or touch it with tweezers or cotton swabs.
caption.es: *No* intentes sacar nada *clavado* en el ojo, ni tocarlo con pinzas o bastoncillos.
caption.fr: *N'essaie pas* de retirer un objet *planté* dans l'œil, ni avec une pince ni avec un coton-tige.
caption.ja: 目に*刺さった*物は取ろうとせず、ピンセットや綿棒で触れないでください。

narration.en: Don't try to remove anything stuck in the eye, and don't use tweezers or cotton swabs. Cover it loosely, and get help.
narration.fr: Ne retire pas un objet planté dans l'œil. Couvre-le sans appuyer.

scenes.svg: <path class='d' data-s='0' data-d='0.9' fill='none' stroke='#1d1d1d' stroke-width='11' d='M 230 800 Q 540 580 850 800 Q 540 1020 230 800 Z'/><circle class='d' data-s='0.5' data-d='0.6' cx='540' cy='800' r='95' fill='none' stroke='#3a86c8' stroke-width='10'/><circle class='f' data-s='0.9' data-d='0.4' data-o='1' cx='540' cy='800' r='40' fill='#1d1d1d' opacity='0'/><path class='d' data-s='0.8' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='12' d='M 540 560 L 560 740'/><path class='d' data-s='1.3' data-d='0.5' fill='none' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='16' d='M 330 560 L 750 1040 M 750 560 L 330 1040'/>

caption.en: Get *urgent care* for chemical splashes (rinse for 15 minutes first), a stuck object, vision changes, or pain that lasts.
caption.es: Busca *atención urgente* si es un químico (enjuaga 15 minutos antes), un objeto clavado, cambios en la vista o dolor que persiste.
caption.fr: Consulte en *urgence* pour une projection chimique (rince 15 minutes d'abord), un objet planté, une vision modifiée ou une douleur persistante.
caption.ja: 薬品が入った（先に15分洗う）、物が刺さった、見えにくい、痛みが続くときは*すぐ受診*を。

narration.en: Get urgent medical care for a chemical splash, after rinsing for fifteen minutes, or for a stuck object, vision changes, or pain or redness that doesn't go away.
narration.fr: Urgence : produit chimique (rince 15 minutes), objet planté, vision altérée ou douleur persistante.
